audience.text: Python developers building applications that require generating barcodes for inventory, retail, logistics, or document labeling without external system dependencies.

capabilities.text: Supports Code 128, Code 39 (base and Extended), EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, and QR Code (Model 2) through dedicated helpers and a generic generate() entry point.
capabilities.title: Generate multiple barcode symbologies

capabilities.text: Each symbology has dedicated options types that control encoding modes, check-digit behavior, and error correction levels.
capabilities.title: Encode with symbology-specific options

capabilities.text: Barcodes render to SVG via to_svg() and to PNG via to_png(), with optional RenderOptions for scale, DPI, module size, colors, and text display.
capabilities.title: Render to SVG and PNG

capabilities.text: Developers can instantiate specific renderer classes like PdfRenderer, SvgRenderer, or PngRenderer and pass them to Barcode.render() for advanced control.
capabilities.title: Custom rendering via Renderer subclasses

limitations.text: PDF rendering is not implemented; calling to_pdf() or PdfRenderer.render() raises NotImplementedError.
The library only generates barcodes and does not decode or read existing barcode images.
ECI normalization and validation are not implemented despite EciHelper fields appearing on EncodeOptions.
GS1 data parsing and validation are not implemented despite Gs1Helper fields appearing on EncodeOptions.

problems_solved.text: Provides a pure-Python, dependency-light way to generate multiple barcode symbologies without requiring native binaries or system-level tools.
Enables deterministic, standards-compliant barcode generation for common linear (Code 128, Code 39, EAN, UPC) and 2D (QR Code) formats.
Supports flexible rendering to SVG and PNG formats with configurable visual properties via RenderOptions.

product_summary.text: Aspose.BarCode FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, open-source library for generating deterministic, standards-compliant linear and 2D barcodes.

uncertainties: The exact set of symbologies supported beyond those explicitly named in examples and public symbols is not fully enumerated.
Whether custom Renderer subclasses beyond PdfRenderer, SvgRenderer, and PngRenderer are defined or supported is not specified.
The behavior of to_pdf() when PDF rendering is eventually implemented is unknown.
The availability of ECI and GS1 functionality in future releases is not confirmed.

workflows.name: Generate and render a barcode
workflows.text: Import a symbology helper or use generate(), encode data, then call to_svg() or to_png() to produce output.

workflows.name: Configure symbology-specific options
workflows.text: Pass options objects such as Code128Options, Code39Options, QrOptions, or UpcaOptions to control encoding behavior and check-digit handling.

workflows.name: Customize rendering appearance
workflows.text: Use RenderOptions to control scale, DPI, module width, text visibility, colors, and quiet zone when rendering barcodes.

workflows.name: Render using a specific renderer
workflows.text: Instantiate a renderer such as SvgRenderer or PngRenderer and pass it to Barcode.render() for fine-grained control over output.
